3510.desc: A rugged Basarios shell. Rare minerals can sometimes be found mixed into it.

3511.desc: Even sturdier than a steel shell, and with a more elegant shape to boot.

3512.desc: Thick, top-grade shell with a real air of majesty. An extremely tough material.

3513.desc: Gypceros Skin, soft and resilient. Many uses from armory to bedding.

3514.desc: The finest skin from Gypceros. Vary rare and valuable.

3515.desc: A stone Gypceros head. So rare that collectors will pay a fortune for one.

3516.desc: A horn that indicates the Teostra's ferocity. You can feel the heat it produces.

3517.desc: A horn carved from an especially violent Teostra. Valued as a piece of art.

3518.desc: So called because those who acquire one are said to have royal ambitions.

3519.desc: A sharp Plesioth fin. Its color changes depending on the angle you view it from.

3520.desc: A top-grade Plesioth fin. Translucent with a beautiful geometric pattern.

3521.desc: This Plesioth fin can't be damaged by water, and will never lose its rich sheen.

3522.desc: The huge claw of the Daimyo Hermitaur is said to be able to slice through anything.

3523.desc: Daimyo strong claw. So many scars that shows long battle experience.

3524.desc: Huge Hermitaur Claw often mistaken for a red stone. Very versatile and durable.

3526.desc: This Tigrex claw is said to become sharper and tougher with each victim it gouges.

3527.desc: A claw carved from a vicious Tigrex. A popular material, but not easy to get hold of.

3528.desc: Colorful Hypnocatrice pelt. Its soft fibers make it a very useful material.

3529.desc: Deep-orange Hypnocatrice pelt that adds a spot of color to a Hunter's outfit.

3530.desc: A rainbow-colored crystal found in a Hypnocatrice's digestive tract.

3532.desc: A sharp Pariapuria fang. Its foul stench makes it rather unpopular with artisans...

3533.desc: A fine Pariapuria fin. Very slimy, and therefore hard to obtain--and craft.

3535.desc: Highly toxic Amber Espinas spike. Poisonous enough to make nearby plants wilt...

3537.desc: An ultramarine Gurenzeburu scale that shines when wet. Has some curious properties.

3538.desc: Hide from a Gurenzeburu's abdomen. Very springy, and a good shock absorber.

3539.desc: One of the claws that holds up the enormous Gurenzeburu. Very dense and heavy.

3540.desc: The horn synonymous with the Gurenzeburu. Tough to break, and requires skill to craft.

3541.desc: A Gurenzeburu wing with a thin, blade-like edge. Take great care when carving.

3542.desc: A Gurenzeburu tail is covered in glowing lumps. Take care when removing them.

3543.desc: A brown Gurenzeburu tail spike. As hard as its claw, and as sharp as a needle.

3544.desc: Opaque blue scales that are slightly different from normal Gurenzeburu scales.

3545.desc: Hide from a Gurenzeburu's belly. Its elasticity makes it a popular material.

3546.desc: A hooked, razor-sharp Gurenzeburu claw. It has claimed many a victim.

3547.desc: Pointy horn said to contain a Gurenzeburu's soul. Not for faint-hearted artisans.

3548.desc: Wings with a ripple pattern are considered to be of a higher quality. Slimy.

3549.desc: A Gurenzeburu tail with some glowing spikes still intact. Stunning to look at.

3550.desc: Spike from a Gurenzeburu's wings or tail whose size denotes its owner's prowess.

3551.desc: Only given to brave Hunters who've proven they can survive the toughest trials.

3552.desc: A special decoration for training purposes. Cannot be created.

3553.desc: A special decoration for training purposes. Cannot be created.

3554.desc: A special decoration for training purposes. Cannot be created.

3555.desc: A special decoration for training purposes. Cannot be created.

3556.desc: An insect found in the mountains. Its brown wings make it look like a rock.

3557.desc: A yellow butterfly found in the mountains, especially during bad weather.

3558.desc: Chubby insect that looks like a barrel, and lives for a surprisingly long time.

3559.desc: A carnivorous insect with a gleaming green body. Handle with care!

3560.desc: A cute little butterfly that's the same pink color as a Congalala.

3561.desc: A mineral with a curious calming effect. Often used as a charm.

3562.desc: A crystal that has become mountain-shaped over time. Very rare and precious.

3563.desc: A leaf that has become encrusted with sweet nectar. (Account Item)

3564.desc: A mountain plant with small white flowers that were once used to make a kind of tea.

3565.desc: Mountain plant whose flowers, like dreams, bloom at dusk and wither at dawn.

3566.desc: Its sharp leaves make this plant dangerous to touch. Used to make clothing.

3567.desc: A plant with bright yellow flowers that grows high above sea level.

3568.desc: A seasonal treat made in Mezeporta. Popular with people of all ages!

3569.desc: A seasonal treat made in Mezeporta. Popular with people of all ages!
fx: Recovery Items Up: +25%; Recovery Items Down: -25%.

3570.desc: A seasonal treat made in Mezeporta. Popular with people of all ages!
fx: Recovery Items Up: +25%; Recovery Items Down: -25%.

3571.desc: The powerful jaw of an Elder Dragon. As you'd expect, a very valuable material.

3572.desc: Strong Elder Dragon webbing. Thin and delicate, so take care when carving.

3573.desc: A sweet-smelling mushroom found in the mountains. Has a bitter taste.

3574.desc: A fish that's found in every season. Don't be fooled by the name--it bites!

3575.desc: Large Burukku horns. Softer than they look, and a good thermal conductor.

3576.desc: Burukku pelt covered in tufts of hair. Stiff to the touch, and a good insulator.

3577.desc: A Burukku's head. Enormous, and very heavy. Popular as a type of headwear.

3578.desc: Erupe's gallant horns. Shape differs, male being larger and harder.

3579.desc: Fluffy Erupe pelt. White as snow, and good at retaining heat and moisture.

3580.desc: The Erupe's large, split hooves allow it to traverse rocky terrain. A rare item.

3581.desc: A special decoration for training purposes. Cannot be created.

3582.desc: Smoothly polished coin with a bewitching shine.

3583.desc: Smoothly polished coin with a glimmering shine.
